scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run prerender
scripts.prerender: vite build --ssr scripts/prerender.tsx --outDir dist-smoke --logLevel error && node dist-smoke/prerender.js
scripts.smoke: vite build --ssr scripts/smoke.tsx --outDir dist-smoke --logLevel error && node dist-smoke/smoke.js
scripts.audit: vite build --ssr scripts/audit.tsx --outDir dist-smoke --logLevel error && node dist-smoke/audit.js
scripts.check:media: vite build --ssr scripts/placeholder-check.tsx --outDir dist-smoke --logLevel error && node dist-smoke/placeholder-check.js
